question.text: How many new suspected measles cases will Bangladesh's DGHS report for the 24 hours to 8:00 am on 13 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves using the DGHS (Directorate General of Health Services, Bangladesh) daily measles bulletin — published in Bengali as "হাম প্রেস রিলিজ" — covering the 24 hours from 8:00 am Bangladesh Standard Time (UTC+6) on 12 November 2026 to 8:00 am on 13 November 2026, which is listed at https://dghs.gov.bd/pages/press-releases (mirrored at https://dghs.gov.bd/pages/news). The resolved value is the bulletin's 24-hour figure for newly identified suspected measles cases (patients with measles-like symptoms) — i.e. the suspected-case line, not the combined suspected-plus-confirmed figure, not laboratory-confirmed cases alone, and not hospital admissions; a value of 1,300 new suspected cases resolves as 1,300. If the bulletin's 24-hour suspected figure cannot be obtained, the value is instead computed as the cumulative suspected-case total reported in the bulletin dated 13 November 2026 minus that reported in the bulletin dated 12 November 2026. If the DGHS bulletin itself cannot be accessed or read at all, the value as reported for that same bulletin by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.
question.fine_print: The bulletin is normally released in the afternoon (local time) of the date it covers; if the 13 November 2026 bulletin is delayed, resolution waits for it rather than annulling. The resolved value is the figure as first published for that bulletin, and any later upward or downward revision by DGHS of that day's count does not change the resolution. If no DGHS bulletin covering a period ending 8:00 am on 13 November 2026 (and no reporting of one) exists at all, the question is annulled.

research:
The latest DGHS bulletin (2 November) reports 1,492 new suspected cases, the highest daily count in the data I found. The question is not settled yet.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: The DGHS press-release page lists daily "হাম প্রেস রিলিজ" entries from 23/10 through 01/11/2026. The 02/11 entry was not yet listed when I checked. The page shows only titles and links, no figures. [DGHS](https://dghs.gov.bd/pages/press-releases)
- 2026-11-02 bulletin (24 h to 8:00 am, Monday 2 Nov), as reported by media:
  - 1,492 new suspected cases and 56 new confirmed cases.
  - Cumulative 231,505 suspected and 23,991 confirmed.
  - 3 suspected deaths, bringing suspected deaths to 1,152 (105 confirmed deaths).
  - 1,385 admissions in 24 h.
  - New suspected cases by division: Dhaka 574, Chattogram 311, Barishal 150, Sylhet 145, Khulna 125, Mymensingh 102, Rajshahi 46, Rangpur 39.
  - [tob.news](https://tob.news/3-die-with-suspected-measles-1492-new-cases-in-24hrs/), [thereport.live](https://thereport.live/health/measles-like-symptoms-claim-3-more-children/%E2%80%8D%E2%80%8Ds-lives/42493)
- 2026-11-01 bulletin: 1,353 suspected plus 64 confirmed (1,417 combined), cumulative 230,013 suspected. [thereport.live](https://thereport.live/health/2-more-children-die-with-measles-symptoms/42460), [Financial Express](https://today.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/last-page/eight-more-die-of-dengue-1929-hospitalised-1793557681?amp=true)
- 2026-10-31 bulletin: I could not find it directly. The cumulative totals imply about 987 suspected cases (230,013 minus 227,673 minus 1,353).

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The 13 November bulletin covers 8:00 am Thursday 12 Nov to 8:00 am Friday 13 Nov. In other words, it is the Friday bulletin covering Thursday, which is a working day.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-02: Dengue is also surging, with 1,970 hospitalised in 24 h and 433 deaths this year, adding strain on hospitals. [Daily Star](https://www.thedailystar.net/news/healthcare/disease/news/6-die-dengue-1970-hospitalised-24-hours-4313826)
- 2026-11-02: The measles bulletin above (1,492 suspected) is the highest daily suspected count I saw in October to November coverage. [Daily Waadaa](https://www.dailywaadaa.com/health/2026/11/02/three-more-children-die-with-measles-symptoms)
- 2026-10-31/11-01: Reuters says the measles death toll is above 1,200 and dengue is unlikely to ease before December. [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-death-toll-from-dengue-rises-unlikely-to-ease-before-december/3086979/)
- 2026-10-29/30: Combined measles deaths reached 1,251. [Dhaka Tribune](https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/health/423299/measles-outbreak-death-toll-reaches-1-251-as-two)

## 4. Base rates
**Daily suspected counts:**
- 25 Oct: 1,280 [Jugantor](https://www.jugantor.com/national/1175224)
- 27 Oct: 1,232
- 28 Oct: 1,322
- 29 Oct: 1,251
- 30 Oct (a Friday bulletin): 1,316
- 31 Oct: about 987 (implied)
- 1 Nov: 1,353
- 2 Nov: 1,492

**Average per day, worked out from cumulative totals:**

| Period | Average per day |
|---|---|
| 14 to 18 Oct | about 1,168 |
| 18 to 30 Oct | about 1,202 |
| 30 Oct to 2 Nov | about 1,277 |
| ISO week 42 (WHO) | about 1,174 |

The trend is flat to slightly rising rather than declining.

**Weekly pattern:**
- Saturday bulletins, which cover Friday (the Bangladeshi weekend), tend to be low:
  - 24 Oct: 1,014 [bdnews24](https://bdnews24.com/health/wqxvwh5x0b)
  - 31 Oct: about 987
  - An earlier Saturday: 816 [UNB tag](https://unb.com.bd/news/tag/154447)
- Other counts I could not reliably date:
  - 980 for 26 Sep
  - 1,074 on 13 Oct (cumulative 207,371) [Jago News](https://www.jagonews24.com/en/national/news/97163)
- Friday bulletins (covering Thursday) look like normal weekday counts. The one I found is 30 Oct at 1,316. I could not confirm the 16 Oct or 23 Oct Friday values.
- Weekday values from 25 Oct to 2 Nov ranged from 1,232 to 1,492. Day-to-day swings are about ±10%, and the post-weekend counts (1 and 2 Nov) ran high, possibly catch-up reporting.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets supplied matches this question. The Kalshi measles markets concern US case counts, and the Polymarket ones are cricket.
- I found no Manifold or Metaculus forecasts or expert projections for Bangladesh's daily count.
- WHO SEARO (21 Oct) described about 1,000 to 1,300 suspected cases per day since early September "with no steady decline" (as quoted in the question background).

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The daily bulletins for 3 to 12 November will show whether the early-November rise (1,353, then 1,492) continues or reverts toward about 1,200.
- The measles-rubella vaccination campaign began on 26 September. I found no reporting on its completion or effect in November.
- The government has the EPI review recommendations, but I found no announced action.
- Dengue is putting extra strain on hospitals, which could affect admissions and reporting.
- Risks to the timing of the 13 Nov bulletin are Friday release habits and any holiday or delay. I found no scheduled holiday on 12 or 13 November, but did not verify this exhaustively.

**Sources not linked above:** [Financial Express measles report](https://thefinancialexpress.com.bd/national/two-more-children-die-with-measles-like-symptoms), [Observer BD](https://observerbd.com/news/603195), [Daily Star](https://www.thedailystar.net/news/healthcare/disease/news/4-more-die-measles-symptoms-24-hours-4299581), [Bangla Tribune](https://www.banglatribune.com/976627)

(a) Time left: about 11 days. The 13 November bulletin should be released on the afternoon of 13 November 2026 (around 14:00 UTC).

(b) Latest known value: the bulletin of 2 November 2026 reported 1,492 new suspected cases. The 1 November bulletin reported 1,353.

(c) If nothing changed: roughly 1,250 to 1,300. That is the recent weekday level, and the 30 October to 2 November average works out to about 1,277 per day.

(d) If the current trend continued: there is a mild upward drift, from about 1,170 per day in mid-October to about 1,280 now. Extending that implies about 1,300 to 1,400 by 12 November. However, the high 1 and 2 November counts may partly be catch-up reporting after the weekend.

(e) Historical variation: single weekday counts vary by about ±10% around the trend. Over 11 days the trend level itself could move by about ±10 to 15%. The 13 November bulletin covers Thursday, a normal working day, so the low Saturday-bulletin pattern (about 800 to 1,000) should not apply. The one Friday bulletin I found (30 October) was 1,316.

(f) Experts and markets: no markets cover this quantity. WHO SEARO describes about 1,000 to 1,300 suspected cases per day "with no steady decline". The question creator's range is 700 to 1,800.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- **Low:** a reporting disruption, data-verification backlog, unexpected holiday or partial reporting from some divisions drops the count below 900. A genuine vaccination-campaign effect could also make the decline faster than expected.
- **High:** continued acceleration (Dhaka surging, hospital strain from dengue pushing more measles cases into formal care), or a batch of delayed reports, pushes the count above 1,700.

- **Percentile 1 (about 760):** a partial or holiday-style reporting day, similar to the Saturday lows of 816 to 987.
- **Percentile 99 (about 1,900):** sustained growth of about 30% plus a catch-up batch.

(f) Expectations of experts and markets:
- WHO describes about 1,000 to 1,300 cases a day with no steady decline.
- There are no markets on this quantity.
- The question creator's range is 700 to 1,800.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- Low: the measles-rubella campaign starts to bite and incidence turns down. A reporting glitch, a holiday or a partial upload could also produce a figure under 900.
- High: the epidemic accelerates in Dhaka or Chattogram, or a backlog of reports is cleared in one bulletin. The figure could then exceed 1,700. A resolver mistakenly using the combined suspected-plus-confirmed figure would add about 60.
